findings.evidence: The proof uses `coefficientMatrix_baseChange`, `coordinateHopfAlgebraBaseChangeIso`, and `CommHopfAlgCat.baseChangeMap_surjective`; their declarations respectively assume only commutative semirings or commutative rings (`MatrixCoefficient/BaseChange.lean:43-46`, `GeneralLinear/Coordinate/BaseChange.lean:67`, and `CommHopfAlgCat/BaseChange.lean:54`). `IsFaithful` itself is declared over `[CommRing k]` in `Faithful/Basic.lean:214-221`.
findings.fix: Replace them with `[CommRing k] [CommRing K] [Algebra k K]`, proving the natural commutative-ring scalar-extension results and specializing them to fields at call sites.
findings.issue: The `[Field k] [Field K]` assumptions unnecessarily restrict both `coordinateBialgHom_baseChange` and `Comodule.IsFaithful.baseChange`; neither result uses division.

summary: The faithful-comodule base-change API is unnecessarily restricted to fields, although its statement and proof work over commutative rings.
